frame: WORLD metres; z = 0.000 = C.APRON_Z = the showroom floor

material.name: SFP_Anodised
material.note: call bake_object_attrs(ob, panel) on anything you emit into this material or it renders untinted

how_to_use.standoff: DO NOT MOUNT FLUSH TO clad_x_e / clad_y_s.  Those are SET-OUT planes; the as-built face runs up to as_built.face_proud_max_mm proud of them once the shim the installed tilt and the oil-canning are added.
how_to_use.coping: bear on coping_bearing_z but read clad_top_edge_z(elev, s): the as-built top edge moves and a coping laid dead flat will rock.
how_to_use.signage: use sign_fix_grid(); every point is >= 40 mm from a joint and on a cassette with a bonded backing plate.
how_to_use.rainwater: use rwp_lines(); the recessed column is already built into the cassettes and the brackets are on the carrier rails.
how_to_use.breach: nothing in this item crosses x = 15.000; as-built max x is reported in build.json as max_x.
